record.question: Which of the following is correct regarding the vindication of acts and character by a Government servant?
options: Prior sanction of the Government is required to approach a court or the press for vindication of any official act subject to adverse criticism or defamation.
Prior sanction is required for vindicating both official acts and private conduct if criticized or defamed.
No prior sanction is needed to approach a court or the press for vindicating an official act under criticism.
Government servants are not permitted to seek vindication of official acts while in service.
